facts.activity_file: responding to slope-radar and prism alarms

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: injury during shift handover on LV-9303

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control GROUND_CONDITION_INSPECTION: the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters on LV-9303 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in monitoring and inspecting ground conditions, specifically responding to slope-radar and prism alarms. LV-9303 (light vehicles) is in service for personnel movement on operating areas. The task proceeded during shift handover while the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters had degraded below its design intent. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 28 September 2012 an incident occurred on LV-9303 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during shift handover, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
